packageRules.description: Stateful services migrate data on upgrade and cannot be downgraded: never automerge, one PR per image.
Major versions need a read of the release notes first; wait for approval on the dashboard.
Omada controller: take a controller backup before merging (see stacks/omada/README.md).
prBodyNotes: **Before merging:** download a controller backup (Settings > Maintenance > Backup). Omada upgrades cannot be rolled back.

packageRules.description: Portainer runs outside GitOps: merging is not enough, re-run bootstrap.sh on each host.
prBodyNotes: **After merging:** `git pull && sudo ./bootstrap.sh <host>` on each host to apply.

packageRules.description: Immich server and machine-learning versions must match: one PR for both.
prBodyNotes: **Before merging:** read the Immich release notes for breaking changes, and diff the release's docker-compose.yml against stacks/immich (see its README). Immich makes its own database dump daily; for a major upgrade, trigger one first (Administration > Job Queues > Create Database Dump).

packageRules.description: Immich's Postgres image changes only when upstream's compose file changes it (a version jump needs a data migration). Allow digest refreshes, never tag changes.
